reply_text.comment: Thank you for reaching out. It appears that your email verification is pending, which is preventing access to your invoices. Please ensure that you have completed the email verification process for your new email address. You can resend the verification email from your account settings. If the issue persists, please contact support directly for further assistance.

messages.content: I have provided a suggested reply to inform you about verifying your new email address. Please check your email inbox and spam folder for the verification email, and resend it if necessary. If you continue to experience issues, contact support for further assistance.
